abstract: Lebanon’s current economic crisis ranks among the worst in recent history. GDP has collapsed by 38% in real terms. The Lebanese lira, which was fixed to the dollar in 1997, has lost more than 98% of its value on the parallel market. The government has defaulted on its debt, and depositors are unable to access their funds held at commercial banks. Consolidated public sector debt, including both government debt and commercial banks’ claims on the Banque du Liban (BdL), represents more than seven times the current GDP. Public services delivery has crumbled. In short, the country is undergoing a debt crisis, a banking crisis, a currency crisis, and a growth collapse. Four years into the crisis, a resolution remains elusive, and each passing day increases the economic and social burdens faced by the population. Given the increasing cost of delaying a resolution, we propose a strategy for Lebanon’s economic recovery that addresses all the dimensions of the crisis while recognizing the need to rapidly kick-start the economic recovery.
abstract_zh: 黎巴嫩当前的经济危机堪称近代史上最严重的危机之一。实际国内生产总值（GDP）暴跌38%。1997年与美元挂钩的黎巴嫩镑，在平行市场已贬值超过98%。政府债务违约，储户无法提取商业银行存款。包括政府债务及商业银行对黎巴嫩央行（BdL）债权在内的公共部门合并债务，已达当前GDP的七倍以上。公共服务体系全面崩溃。简言之，该国正同时经历债务危机、银行危机、货币危机与增长崩溃。危机爆发四年后，解决方案仍遥不可及，而每拖延一日，民众承受的经济与社会负担便愈发沉重。鉴于拖延解决的成本日益攀升，我们提出一项兼顾危机各维度、同时亟需快速启动经济复苏的黎巴嫩经济复苏战略。
title: Towards a Sustainable Recovery for Lebanon’s Economy
title_zh: 迈向黎巴嫩经济的可持续复苏

abstract: High-skilled migration programs exist around the world in the hope that immigrants complement native workers, allow firms to grow, and boost innovation. We study the effect of one such program by exploiting the 2016 extension of the Optional Practical Training (OPT) program, which significantly prolonged the work authorization period for international STEM graduates. Using a synthetic difference-in-differences approach, we find that the policy successfully increased the local supply of high-skilled immigrants in exposed Commuting Zones. This local inflow stimulated firm creation and the demand for native high-skilled workers. The program might have also boosted innovation in certain sectors and startup investment, especially in Commuting Zones hosting top-ranked universities, where, overall, the effects tend to be larger.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内存在高技能移民项目，旨在期望移民能够补充本土劳动力、促进企业扩张并推动创新。我们通过研究2016年选择性实习培训（OPT）项目的扩展（该政策显著延长了国际STEM毕业生的合法工作期限），分析了此类项目的影响。采用合成双重差分法，我们发现该政策成功增加了受影响通勤区的高技能移民本地供给。这种本地流入刺激了企业创立以及对本土高技能劳动力的需求。该政策还可能促进了特定行业的创新和初创企业投资，尤其是在拥有顶尖大学的通勤区——这些地区的整体效应往往更为显著。
title: The Effect of Retaining High-Skilled International Graduates: Evidence from the STEM OPT Extension
title_zh: 保留高技能国际毕业生的效应：来自STEM OPT延期的证据

abstract: We analyze the effects of bans on exports at the level of 5,000 products and show how our results can inform economic sanctions against Russia after its invasion of Ukraine. We begin with characterizing export restrictions imposed by the EU and the US until mid-May 2022. We then propose a theoretically-grounded criterion for targeting export bans at the 6-digit HS level. Our results show that the cost to Russia are highly convex in the market share of the sanctioning parties, i.e., there are large benefits from coordinating export bans among a broad coalition of countries. Applying our results to Russia, we find that sanctions imposed by the EU and the US are not systematically related to our arguments once we condition on Russia’s total imports of a product from participating countries. Quantitative evaluations of the export bans show (i) that they are very effective with the welfare loss typically ∼100 times larger for Russia than for the sanctioners. (ii) Improved coordination of the sanctions and targeting sanctions based on our criterion allows to increase the costs to Russia by about 60% with little to no extra cost to the sanctioners. (iii) There is scope for increasing the cost to Russia further by expanding the set of sanctioned products.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了5000种产品层面的出口禁令效应，并展示了研究结果如何为俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后对其采取的经济制裁提供依据。首先，我们梳理了截至2022年5月中旬欧盟与美国实施的出口限制措施。随后，我们提出一个基于理论依据的六位HS编码层面出口禁令目标选择标准。研究结果表明，俄罗斯承担的成本与制裁方的市场份额呈高度凸性关系，即广泛国家联盟协调实施出口禁令能带来显著收益。将研究结果应用于俄罗斯案例时发现，在控制俄罗斯从参与国进口某产品的总量后，欧盟与美国的制裁措施与我们的理论依据并不存在系统性关联。对出口禁令的量化评估显示：（i）制裁效果显著，俄罗斯的福利损失通常约为制裁方的100倍；（ii）通过优化制裁协调并基于我们的标准精准选择制裁目标，可在几乎不增加制裁方额外成本的情况下，使俄罗斯承担的成本提升约60%；（iii）通过扩大受制裁产品范围，仍有进一步提升俄罗斯成本的潜力。

title: On the Design of Effective Sanctions: The Case of Bans on Exports to Russia
title_zh: 有效制裁的设计：对俄出口禁令案例研究

abstract: A central insight from neoclassical economics is that international trade operates like an improvement in production technology. It generates mutual aggregate welfare gains for countries as a whole, but creates winners and losers within countries. Tariffs are a tax on this trading technology and distort the prices faced by domestic consumers and producers. Large countries can use tariffs to improve their terms of trade on world markets. But if all countries try to do so, they can end up with lower welfare than if they cooperated to liberalize trade. Tariffs can be used to redistribute income between the winners and losers from trade within countries. But there can be other more efficient ways to achieve redistribution. Policies to promote economic activity in critical industries can be rationalized based on externalities or national security. But these arguments typically rationalize targeted policies towards those industries and tariffs can be dominated by other policy interventions. Empirical findings from the recent waves of U.S. tariffs suggest that most of the incidence of these tariffs has been borne by U.S. importers, wholesalers, retailers and consumers rather than by foreign exporters. These tariffs have led to a large-scale reorganization of U.S. supply chains away from China to third countries. Although this reorganization has substantially reduced China’s share of U.S. imports, the U.S. remains indirectly exposed to China through the imports of these third countries.
abstract_zh: 新古典经济学的核心观点认为，国际贸易如同生产技术的改进，能为各国整体带来相互的福利增益，但也会在国家内部产生赢家和输家。关税是对这种贸易技术征收的税收，会扭曲国内消费者和生产者面临的价格。大国可以利用关税改善其在世界市场上的贸易条件。但如果所有国家都试图这样做，最终可能比合作实现贸易自由化时的福利水平更低。关税可用于在国家内部贸易赢家和输家之间进行收入再分配，但可能存在其他更有效的再分配方式。基于外部性或国家安全理由，可以合理化对关键产业的经济活动促进政策，但这些论点通常支持对这些产业实施针对性政策，而关税可能被其他政策干预手段所取代。近期美国关税浪潮的实证结果表明，这些关税的负担主要由美国进口商、批发商、零售商和消费者承担，而非外国出口商。这些关税导致美国供应链大规模重组，从中国转向第三国。尽管这种重组大幅降低了中国在美国进口中的份额，但美国仍通过从这些第三国的进口间接暴露于中国的影响之下。

title: The Economics of Tariffs

abstract: Abstract Cyberattacks on small banks have direct and spillover effects in local markets. Following successful cyberattacks, hacked small banks experience a decline in deposit growth rates. This effect of cyberattacks is not observed in hacked large banks. Cyberattacks on small banks also increase the local market share of large banks through positive deposit spillovers. The consequent change in market structure reduces credit access for small borrowers and impedes small establishment growth. Our findings show that, unlike large banks, small banks are not seen by depositors as having the resources to maintain adequate cybersecurity systems to protect customers from evolving cyber threats.
abstract_zh: 摘要 针对小银行的网络攻击在当地市场具有直接效应和溢出效应。在遭受成功的网络攻击后，被攻击的小银行存款增长率出现下降。这一网络攻击效应在大银行中并未观察到。对小银行的网络攻击还通过正向存款溢出效应，提升了大型银行在当地市场的份额。由此导致的市场结构变化，减少了小借款人的信贷获取渠道，并阻碍了小企业机构的增长。我们的研究结果表明，与大型银行不同，存款人认为小银行缺乏足够的资源来维持适当的网络安全系统，以保护客户免受不断演变的网络威胁。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Cyberattacks on Small Banks and the Impact on Local Banking Markets
title_zh: 针对小型银行的网络攻击及其对地方银行市场的影响

abstract: Abstract Germany's Renewable Energy Sources Act (REA), enacted in 2000 and subsequently amended, subsidized national renewable energy production with fixed feed‐in tariffs for renewable energy sources (RE) from wind, solar, and biogas. Empirical studies suggest that the policy was creating windfall effects for landowners and attribute farmland use homogenization to the policy. Empirical evidence, however, lacks a comprehensive and systemic analysis of the REA impact on farmland values, farm structures, and farmland heterogeneity. To understand the policy's impact channels, we propose five hypotheses, build a spatial price theory‐informed structural equation model (SEM) and test it on a rich dataset of land transactions and land uses for the Federal State of Brandenburg, 2005–2018. The SEM uncovers direct impact channels on farmland prices from an increased willingness to pay more in proximity to wind turbines and biogas plants, and on farmland heterogeneity by incentivizing maize‐based homogenous crop rotations. Indirect impact channels for biogas promotion on land prices via altering the farm structure reveal additional and larger impacts than previous studies suggested. Approximately 9% of the price increase could be attributed to the RE expansion over the study period. Future policy amendments should take such a systemic perspective and counteract adverse effects.
abstract_zh: 摘要 德国《可再生能源法》（REA）自2000年颁布并历经修订，通过为风能、太阳能及沼气等可再生能源（RE）设定固定上网电价，对国内可再生能源生产给予补贴。实证研究表明，该政策为土地所有者带来了意外收益，并将农田利用的同质化归因于此政策。然而，现有实证证据缺乏对REA影响农田价值、农场结构及农田异质性的全面系统性分析。为理解该政策的影响渠道，我们提出五项假设，构建了一个基于空间价格理论的结构方程模型（SEM），并利用勃兰登堡州2005年至2018年间丰富的土地交易与土地利用数据对其进行检验。SEM揭示了直接的影响渠道：靠近风力涡轮机和沼气厂区域的土地支付意愿增加，从而推高农田价格；同时，政策通过激励以玉米为主的同质化轮作模式，影响农田异质性。对于沼气推广通过改变农场结构间接影响土地价格的渠道，本研究发现其影响程度较以往研究更为显著且规模更大。在研究期间，约9%的价格上涨可归因于可再生能源的扩张。未来的政策修订应采取此类系统性视角，并应对不利效应加以遏制。
title: Uncovering renewable energy policy impact channels on land values, the local farm structure, and farmland heterogeneity
title_zh: 揭示可再生能源政策对土地价值、地方农场结构及农田异质性的影响渠道

abstract: Abstract While multiple factors explain low adoption rates of improved varieties by small‐scale farmers in sub‐Saharan Africa, a key supply‐side constraint is the limited availability of seed embodying new traits in the volume, quality, price, and timeliness required by farmers. This constraint is partly attributable to classical failures in the market for seeds and traits. Historically, governments have remedied this failure by allocating public resources to varietal improvement and seed distribution. In 2011, the Government of Ethiopia launched a novel experiment—the direct seed marketing approach—to encourage private seed investment in the country's seed system and to reduce the state's footprint in the system. Direct seed marketing incentivized seed companies to sell directly to farmers rather than through state distribution channels. This study provides the first quantitative assessment of the impact of direct seed marketing based on key indicators of a robust seed system: access to seed and farm‐level productivity. Using a quasi‐experimental difference‐in‐differences approach suitable to handling variation in treatment timing, we find that direct seed marketing increased the share of farmers purchasing fresh maize seed by 15 percentage points. It also raised the quantity of maize seed purchased by 45% and improved maize yields by 18%. In contrast, direct seed marketing had no effect on wheat seed purchases and yields. These crop‐specific differences likely reflect underlying differences in the reproductive biology of maize and wheat, highlighting the importance of crop‐specific policy design, institutional arrangements, and market development strategies to accelerate the adoption of improved varieties.
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管多种因素解释了撒哈拉以南非洲小农户对改良品种采用率低的原因，但一个关键的供给侧制约因素是以农民所需的数量、质量、价格和及时性提供体现新性状的种子供应有限。这一制约部分归因于种子和性状市场中的典型失灵。历史上，政府通过将公共资源分配给品种改良和种子分销来弥补这一失灵。2011年，埃塞俄比亚政府启动了一项新颖的实验——直接种子营销方法——以鼓励私营部门在该国种子体系中的投资，并减少国家在该体系中的足迹。直接种子营销激励种子公司直接向农民销售，而非通过国家分销渠道。本研究基于稳健种子体系的关键指标——种子获取和农场层面生产力——首次对直接种子营销的影响进行了定量评估。采用适合处理处理时间变化的准实验双重差分方法，我们发现直接种子营销使购买新鲜玉米种子的农民比例提高了15个百分点。它还使购买的玉米种子数量增加了45%，并将玉米产量提高了18%。相比之下，直接种子营销对小麦种子购买和产量没有影响。这些作物特异性差异可能反映了玉米和小麦生殖生物学上的根本差异，凸显了作物特异性政策设计、制度安排和市场发展战略在加速改良品种采用方面的重要性。
title: Seeds of change: The impact of Ethiopia's direct seed marketing approach on smallholders' seed purchases and productivity
title_zh: 变革的种子：埃塞俄比亚直接种子营销方式对小农户种子购买及生产力的影响

abstract: We surveyed all Chinese public firms in 2019 and 2022 to examine the real effects of financial markets. Over 90% of firms say they actively monitor the stock market, and the most common reasons they provide are that they learn new information from the price and that they depend on the price for financing. Focusing on the learning channel, we examine how the responses relate to firm characteristics and actions. Firms that indicate learning have characteristics that suggest greater benefit from market information. They also exhibit higher investment-to-price sensitivity. We provide results on what dimensions of information firms learn about.
abstract_zh: 我们于2019年和2022年调查了所有中国上市公司，以考察金融市场的实际效应。超过90%的企业表示积极关注股票市场，其最常提及的原因是，它们从价格中获取新信息，并依赖价格进行融资。聚焦于学习渠道，我们考察了这些回应如何与企业特征及行为相关联。表明存在学习行为的企业，其特征显示出从市场信息中获益更大。它们还表现出更高的投资-价格敏感性。我们提供了关于企业学习信息维度的结果。

title: Market feedback: Evidence from the horse’s mouth

abstract: The distinctive traits of early settlers at the initial stages of institutional development may be crucial for cultural formation. In 1973, cultural geographer Wilbur Zelinsky formalized this idea in his doctrine of “First Effective Settlement.” I examine this doctrine and identify its short- and long-run implications for gender norms in the United States. To capture counties at early stages of cultural and institutional development, I focus on county creation events and proxy early settlers’ gender norms using historical female labor force participation rates and women’s financial rights in their places of origin. I document the distinctive characteristics of early settler populations and provide suggestive evidence of the transmission of gender norms across space and time. The results show that women’s labor supply is higher, both in the short and long run, in United States counties that historically hosted larger foreign-born early settler populations from places with high female labor force participation. I provide evidence for four reinforcing mechanisms underlying this persistence: foundational influence during critical junctures, demographic dominance, intergenerational cultural transmission, and political dominance. Together, these findings shed new light on how immigrants’ cultural endowments can have durable effects when introduced during critical junctures of institutional formation in host societies.
abstract_zh: 制度发展初期早期定居者的独特特征可能对文化形成至关重要。1973年，文化地理学家威尔伯·泽林斯基在其“首次有效定居”学说中正式阐述了这一观点。本文考察了这一学说，并识别其对美国性别规范的短期与长期影响。为捕捉处于文化与制度发展早期阶段的县，我聚焦于县的创建事件，并以历史女性劳动力参与率及女性在原籍地的金融权利作为早期定居者性别规范的代理指标。我记录了早期定居者群体的独特特征，并提供了性别规范在空间与时间上传递的提示性证据。结果表明，在历史上接纳了来自高女性劳动力参与率地区的外国出生早期定居者人口较多的美国县，女性劳动力供给在短期和长期内均更高。我为这种持续性提供了四种强化机制的证据：关键节点时期的基础性影响、人口主导性、代际文化传递以及政治主导性。综合来看，这些发现为移民的文化禀赋在宿主社会制度形成的关键节点引入时如何产生持久影响提供了新的见解。
source_issue: Journal of Comparative Economics, Volume 54, Issue 2
title: Settlers and norms

abstract: Obtaining valid answers from respondents has been a central concern of stated preference (SP) studies. In contrast, sample representativeness is the main focus of current public polling accuracy debates, largely due to declining survey response rates. We introduce the multi-level regression and post-stratification (MRP) modelling approach to welfare estimation using discrete choice models. Through Monte Carlo simulations and two water resource valuation surveys, we demonstrate how MRP can help researchers to (i) generate population-relevant welfare measures from non-representative samples, (ii) estimate preference heterogeneity and distributional impacts across people, and (iii) evaluate the impacts of removing potentially invalid responses using a consistent target population frame. We propose MRP as a complementary modelling approach for non-market valuation data and discuss its opportunities and limitations.
abstract_zh: 从受访者处获取有效答案一直是陈述偏好（SP）研究的核心关注点。相比之下，样本代表性则是当前民意调查准确性争论的主要焦点，这主要归因于调查回复率的下降。我们引入多级回归与事后分层（MRP）建模方法，用于基于离散选择模型的福利估计。通过蒙特卡洛模拟及两项水资源价值评估调查，我们展示了MRP如何帮助研究者：（i）从非代表性样本中生成与总体相关的福利度量；（ii）估计人群间的偏好异质性与分配影响；（iii）在一致的目标总体框架下，评估剔除潜在无效回答的影响。我们提出将MRP作为非市场价值评估数据的补充建模方法，并讨论其机遇与局限性。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 138
title: Multi-level regression and post-stratification for discrete choice modelling and stated preference research
title_zh: 离散选择建模与陈述偏好研究中的多层次回归与事后分层

abstract: We study optimal stopping for diffusion processes with unknown model primitives within the continuous-time reinforcement learning (RL) framework Wang, Zariphopoulou and Zhou [Wang H, Zariphopoulou T, Zhou XY (2020), J. Machine Learn. Res. 21(198):1-34], and present applications to option pricing and portfolio choice. By penalizing the corresponding variational inequality formulation, we transform the stopping problem into a stochastic optimal control problem with two actions. We then randomize controls into Bernoulli distributions and add an entropy regularizer to encourage exploration. We derive a semianalytical optimal Bernoulli distribution, based on which we devise RL algorithms using the martingale approach Jia and Zhou [Jia Y, Zhou XY (2022a) J. Machine Learn. Res. 23(154):1–55]. We establish a policy improvement theorem and prove the fast convergence of the resulting policy iterations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithms in pricing finite-horizon American put options, solving Merton’s problem with transaction costs, and scaling to high-dimensional optimal stopping problems. In particular, we show that both the offline and online algorithms achieve high accuracy in learning the value functions and characterizing the associated free boundaries. This paper has been accepted by Kay Giesecke for the Special Issue on AI for Finance and Business Decisions. Funding: M. Dai was supported by the Hong Kong Research Grants Council [15212324, 15217123, 15213422, and T32-615/24-R], the Hong Kong Polytechnic University [P0042708, P0042456, and P0039114], and the Key Project of National Natural Science Foundation of China [72432005]. Y. Sun acknowledges financial support from a start-up fund at Peking University HSBC Business School. Z. Xu acknowledges financial support from The Hong Kong RGC [GRF 15204622, 15203423], NSFC 12571517, the PolyU-SDU Joint Research Center on Financial Mathematics, the CAS AMSS-PolyU Joint Laboratory of Applied Mathematics, the Research Centre for Quantitative Finance (1-CE03), and internal grants from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. X. Zhou was supported by the Nie Center for Intelligent Asset Management at Columbia University. This work was also part of a Columbia-CityU/HK collaborative project that was supported by the InnoHK Initiative, the Government of the HKSAR, and the AIFT Lab. abstract_zh: 我们在连续时间强化学习（RL）框架Wang, Zariphopoulou和Zhou [Wang H, Zariphopoulou T, Zhou XY (2020), J. Machine Learn. Res. 21(198):1-34]内研究具有未知模型原语的扩散过程的最优停止问题，并给出其在期权定价和投资组合选择中的应用。通过惩罚相应的变分不等式表述，我们将停止问题转化为具有两个动作的随机最优控制问题。随后，我们将控制随机化为伯努利分布，并加入熵正则化项以鼓励探索。我们推导出一个半解析的最优伯努利分布，并基于此利用鞅方法Jia和Zhou [Jia Y, Zhou XY (2022a) J. Machine Learn. Res. 23(154):1–55]设计RL算法。我们建立了一个策略改进定理，并证明了由此产生的策略迭代的快速收敛性。我们展示了这些算法在为有限期限美式看跌期权定价、求解带交易成本的Merton问题以及扩展到高维最优停止问题方面的有效性。特别地，我们表明离线算法和在线算法在学习值函数以及刻画相关自由边界方面均达到了高精度。本文已被Kay Giesecke接受，用于AI for Finance and Business Decisions特刊。资助：M. Zhou得到哥伦比亚大学Nie智能资产管理中心的资助。这项工作也是Columbia-CityU/HK合作项目的一部分，该项目得到InnoHK Initiative、香港特别行政区政府以及AIFT Lab的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07614获取。
